observations: Black and red stationary exercise bike.
The brand 'FITNESS' is visible on the front wheel rim in photo 0.
The bike has a padded seat, handlebars with integrated grips, and a console mounted on the frame.
The unit is equipped with a flywheel and a base stand.
A watermark 'AMERICAN SPORT LIMITED' is present on the image.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The flywheel may be noisy or the resistance mechanism may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled through its full resistance range.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty or noisy flywheel

risks.risk: The console may have a dead battery or a broken screen.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the console powered on and displaying metrics.
risks.if_unproven: as a console with a broken screen

risks.risk: The pedals may be worn or the straps may be broken.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the pedals and the foot straps.
risks.if_unproven: as having worn or broken pedals

proof_requests: Video of the bike being pedaled to demonstrate the flywheel and resistance working.
Photo of the console screen while powered on.
Close-up photo of the pedals and foot straps.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
